extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Sources of light — natural sources exist in nature without humans: sun (most important), stars, fireflies, lightning, glowing lava. Artificial sources are made by humans: electric bulb, torch, candle, lamp, tubelight. Classify by asking: did humans make it or does it exist by itself? (2) Luminous and non-luminous — luminous objects give out their own light (sun, lit candle, lit bulb, firefly, stars). Non-luminous objects do NOT give out light (book, chair, ball, moon, mirror). The moon is non-luminous — it reflects sunlight, does not make its own light. (3) Transparent, translucent, opaque — transparent: lets all light pass through, see clearly (clear glass, water, clear plastic). Translucent: lets some light pass through, see blurred (oiled paper, butter paper, frosted glass). Opaque: blocks all light, cannot see through (wooden door, book, metal plate, stone wall). (4) Formation of shadows — shadow is a dark shape formed when an opaque object blocks light. Three things needed: light source, opaque object, and a surface. Light travels in straight lines and cannot bend around objects. Shadow shape matches object outline. Shadow is always opposite to the light source direction. Moving object closer to light = bigger shadow. Moving object closer to surface = smaller shadow. Only opaque objects cast clear shadows. Transparent objects do not cast dark shadows. Misconceptions: 'the moon is a luminous object because it shines' (the moon is NON-luminous — it reflects sunlight, it does not make its own light), 'light can bend around corners' (light travels in STRAIGHT lines — it cannot bend around objects, which is why shadows form), 'transparent objects cast dark shadows' (transparent objects let light pass through, so they do NOT cast dark shadows — only OPAQUE objects cast dark shadows), 'a shadow forms on the same side as the light' (the shadow forms on the OPPOSITE side from the light source — if light comes from the right, shadow falls on the left), 'translucent and transparent are the same' (transparent lets ALL light through and you see clearly, translucent lets SOME light through and you see blurred — they are different). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function LightGame), NOT export default. Export interface LightGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
